title: BlockBack
description: Restore stripped logs, dirt paths, and tilled farmland with a click.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/feff29543d00ea6eefde5730c3e9f1a5a31204f6.png)

BlockBack lets players reverse common block transformations with a right-click. Unstrip logs to restore bark, turn dirt paths back into grass blocks, and untill farmland back to dirt.

Lightweight, Folia-safe, and survival-friendly with no commands or setup required. Compatible with Paper and Folia 1.21+.

Built for survival SMPs, creative servers, and any community where players need to undo common block changes without WorldEdit, creative mode, or admin intervention.

![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb0f0341a0bb4aae58d1f44dfeafd77c341f283b.png)

### BarkBack - Log Restoration

![Bark Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3deb5fd4befb150e14a35964635cc56d354aebfb.gif)

Right-click any stripped log with an axe to restore its bark. Also known as unstripping.

- Preserves log orientation and placement
- Works with all 10 wood types: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, crimson, and warped
- Includes stripped wood blocks and stripped bamboo

### PathBack - Path Restoration

![Path Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2fdb8d64e7b22f24ea5169d38246c8acb9af057.gif)

Right-click a dirt path (formerly known as grass path) with a shovel to convert it back to dirt.

- Perfect for undoing accidental path creation
- Useful for terraforming and landscaping
- Maintains natural terrain appearance

### FarmBack - Farmland Restoration

![Farm Back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d91f1ac6eff7e541c4bcb8a9a04665e57c6fcc9.gif)

Right-click farmland with a hoe to revert it back to dirt.

- Essential for changing farm layouts
- Cleans up abandoned farms without breaking and replacing blocks
- No more accidental farmland from sprinting players

![installation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3f658e10f059474003ea90cba3e3560bb0e30bb.png)

1. Download the latest BlockBack.jar from the Files section
2. Place the file in your server's `plugins/` directory
3. Start your server to generate configuration files
4. Done. Players can use every feature immediately with no permissions setup required.

![commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88dbbfe52b093fb16bcb187c9b5f568ed1e74dbe.png)

| Command | Description |
|----------------------|------------------------------------|
| `/blockback` | View your current feature settings |
| `/barkback` | Toggle BarkBack on/off |
| `/pathback` | Toggle PathBack on/off |
| `/farmback` | Toggle FarmBack on/off |
| `/blockback reload` | Reload configurations |

Each feature is toggleable per-player, so players who don't want it can opt out without affecting anyone else.

![permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8827807b3879bdc04e52ea0c9e63298234a09288.png)

| Permission | Description | Default |
|----------------------|------------------------------------|------------------|
| `blockback.use` | Default Use | Everyone |
| `blockback.bark` | Use BarkBack | Everyone |
| `blockback.path` | Use PathBack | Everyone |
| `blockback.farm` | Use FarmBack | Everyone |
| `blockback.reload` | Reload configurations | Operators only |

Default permissions ensure immediate functionality while maintaining admin control. No permissions plugin required.

![whywho](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e13f70c17afb7b2f2ec8be9204670ce9592d8a36.png)

### For Server Owners

- No tutorials needed, no commands required, no config edits to get started
- Folia-safe and lightweight with negligible TPS impact
- Works alongside protection plugins, claims plugins, and WorldGuard
- Each feature can be globally disabled in the config

### For Players

- Intuitive controls using the right tool for each block
- Toggle individual features on or off to match your playstyle
- Makes building, terraforming, and farm management faster
- No need to break and replace blocks to fix small mistakes

### Support

- **Issues and feature requests:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/your-repo-here)
